name: Billing System of Record
description: The charges as billed for the active cycle: monthly recurring, one-time, device-loan installments, discounts and tax lines. Every 'current amount' on an impacted-accounts row is read from here.

name: Anomaly-Detection Engine
description: The rule and ML layers that flag out-of-policy charges, plus the grouping agent that collapses them into patterns with a shared root cause. Produces the 207 anomalies and the six groups.

name: Rate-Card and Plan Catalog
description: Plan pricing, promotional rates and migration effective dates. What a charge should have been, against which the billed amount is reconciled.

name: Tax-Rule Engine and Jurisdiction Tables
description: State and local rate tables by jurisdiction, versioned. The Incorrect State Tax pattern exists because this source was still on the pre-January version when the cycle ran — the gap is visible here rather than inferred.

name: Account and Payment-Method History
description: Enrollment state and payment-method changes per account. This is what separates a real missing-discount error from a legitimate change the customer made themselves.

name: Rebilling API
description: Executes approved bulk corrections and returns a rebill ID per account. Write path — nothing reaches a customer's bill without a reviewed action, and every call is logged to Resolution History.

name: Confidence-Scoring Agent
description: Scores every detected anomaly against the tier thresholds the Platform Admin sets. The per-account score on an impacted-accounts row comes from here, not from the pattern average.

name: Agent Observability Runtime
description: Accuracy, latency (mean, P95, P99), error rate and inference counts for the four pipeline agents. The Root Cause Analysis warning is a reading from this source, not a heuristic.

name: Model Registry and Retraining Feedback Loop
description: The deployed model tag (v2.4.1) and the operator corrections captured as labeled training data. Every correction an operator makes here becomes next month's detection.

name: Resolution History and Governance Log
description: The audit trail: who approved what, at which confidence tier, before and after amounts, rebill ID and timestamp. Written as the operator acts rather than reconstructed afterwards.
